result.summary: Found two potential usability issues: low-contrast text and content that does not match the selected category.

issues.description: The Pizza category is selected, but the visible recommendations include ramen, burgers and poké.
issues.suggestion: Filter the restaurant lists to match the selected category, or clarify if these sections are intentionally unfiltered.

issues.description: The search placeholder and inactive bottom navigation labels have low contrast against their light backgrounds.
issues.suggestion: Use darker text colors to meet accessibility contrast requirements.
